correctness.rationale: The incidence kernel splits along edge-disjoint cycle circuits. Uniform intrinsic volume is carried to independent uniform factors under a fixed linear isomorphism. Full Dirichlet gap second moments establish the cycle covariance coefficient (k+2)/(12k); bridge variance is 1/12. Taking trace and applying the weighted matrix-tree theorem gives exactly the stated inertia, isotropic constant, and all integer equality cases. Eight exact rational cactus checks and one exact non-cactus tetrahedral integration test were independently replayed; finite tests do not supply the proof.

value.rationale: A natural infinite geometric family exhibits exact graph-independent solid-volume inertia at fixed vertex and cycle counts. The full covariance and isotropic constant retain meaningful precise cycle data, sharp fixed-n extremal bounds are attained, and a rational exact overlapping-cycle example delineates the limit of the structural law. This is a motivated natural invariant, not a routine relabeling or arbitrary small parameter slice.
